method: Built-in imagegen for every painted asset; Core Graphics for resizing, positioning, alpha compositing, and arch export.
master:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: original botanical garden illustration, art-direction master for a layered portfolio hero.
Create one exquisite portrait painting, 2:3 aspect ratio, intended 2000 x 3000 pixels, sRGB. Full rectangular scene, no arch or window frame.
Original mid-century hand-painted gouache and watercolor botanical plate aesthetic, inspired by the detailed floral craftsmanship of Vittorio Accornero's 1966 Flora without copying any existing print, brand artwork, or recognizable arrangement. Museum-quality botanical accuracy. Translucent layered pigment, fine petal veins, tiny hairline painted highlights, soft granulation and subtle paper texture. No vector shapes, black outlines, 3D, photographic textures, glossy rendering, smooth airbrush or cartoon.
A real old-world formal garden at night with strong three-dimensional spatial depth. Ink navy sky turns plum toward a misty horizon at exactly half the image height. Sparse tiny stars, a few thin hand-painted clouds, small full moon at x=76%, y=18% with cool soft light from right. The top corners may contain trailing foliage. Maintain mostly open sky in the top half.
Two soft ranges of distant hills with subtly lit crests and tiny horizon trees and cypresses. Lawn of painted muted olive/bottle-green/blue-green grass recedes toward central horizon. A pale gravel walkway starts fairly wide at bottom center and winds gently to a vanishing point at x=50%, y=51%; never block this path. Several slender dark cypress trees flank the path at diminishing scales, their tops BELOW y=38% to avoid window bar area. Delicate drifts of small pink, white and blue flowers follow the path. Spacious empty lawn.
At lower left and lower right, lavish dense corner bouquets close to viewer, overlapping lush folded leaves, buds, berries and different flowers at distinct heights, some cut off by side and bottom edges; botanical specimen detail. Keep central bottom corridor x=40%-60% open. Flowers include luminous scarlet red poppies with black basal blotches and dark centers, a layered rose-pink peony, violet bearded irises with upright standards and yellow beards on falls and sword leaves, yellow trumpet narcissi, orange recurved spotted tiger lily, creamy white lilies, notched pink wild roses, violet dark-center anemones, blue cornflowers, yellow marigolds, a tulip, rose hips, dark berries, dandelion clocks, small white and pink blossoms. Deeper petal bases fade to pale edges with shadows in overlapping curls; folded leaves have a pale midrib, one darker side and a thin lit edge. Muted leaves make luminous scarlet, vermilion, rose, yellow, violet, cobalt, cream petals glow. Faint warm indoor light touches nearest flowers, moon gives right cool rims.
Thin restrained sprays trail inward and down from the extreme TOP corners: blue morning glory trumpets with white stars on left; wild roses, violet anemones and rose hips on right. Never obstruct open middle sky. Balanced intentional asymmetric arrangements, not wallpaper or even scatter.
Critical overlay-safe zones: future horizontal window bar lies at y=34%, future vertical bar at x=50% ONLY from y=0 to 34%. No moon, flower heads or other key subject crosses these lines; keep the horizontal band y=32%-36% calm and sky-only where possible. Important moon lies safely inside future arch; above horizon sky remains airy. No insects in this master; insect assets will be separately painted and later placed small.
No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks, logos, monograms, brand marks, people, animals, buildings, frame, arch, neon, lens flare, fantasy or glow effects. Flowers must be recognizable real species and the path visible continuously to horizon.
layersA: Extract and repaint ONLY the night sky background as a complete opaque rectangular portrait painting. Preserve reference moon position around x=76%, y=13%, diameter 6% of width, stars and delicate cloud placement. REMOVE every flower, plant, leaf, tree, hill, structure, lawn, path and foreground object. Fill all revealed regions with continuously painted sky. Deep ink navy at top gradates into quiet plum around y=48%-52%, then dark muted plum-blue in the bottom half. No luminous starburst effects; stars tiny and painted. Full opaque sky everywhere, no transparent pixels. Open upper corners and open center. This is the background under every other layer. No horizon silhouette or objects anywhere. Rich translucent watercolor washes, gentle gouache dry brush, soft pigment granulation, understated archival paper texture. More obviously handmade and flatter painterly brushwork than reference, never photo texture. Portrait 2:3, intended 2000x3000.

Create ONLY the far-distance landscape layer on an ACTUAL TRANSPARENT background, matching the reference composition and color mood. Full-size portrait 2:3 canvas intended 2000x3000. Keep precisely the full-frame alignment: horizon at y=49%-50%. Two gentle ranges of distant blue-plum hills with cool crest light; farthest rises no higher than y=44%; sparse small horizon trees and a few slender distant cypresses, no buildings. Hills and trees concentrated y=44%-59%, taper through mist, and continue painted terrain downward to y=73% so a foreground lawn will cover the lower portion with ample hidden overlap (at least 60 final pixels). Everything above the hills and outside the landscape is true transparency, especially all of y=0%-42%. No sky, moon, stars, cloud background, lawn/path, flowers or close cypresses. NO white/checkerboard fill. Mist is soft semitransparent pigment only around horizon y=50%-60%. New original hand-painted mid-century botanical gouache/watercolor, visibly painted washes and subtle granulation, no photographic texture. Do not crop tightly around subject; preserve the entire 2:3 canvas with large empty transparent upper area.

Create ONLY the middle-distance garden ground layer on an ACTUAL TRANSPARENT background, using reference perspective and path as guides. Full portrait 2:3 frame intended 2000x3000. Horizon/vanishing point x=50%, y=51%. The lawn begins at y=50%, fills the entire lower frame solidly to the left/right/bottom edges, painted muted olive and blue-green grass. Pale gravel path recedes continuously to horizon at 51% image height and gently winds, broadening to x=39%-61% at the bottom. Leave this corridor entirely unobstructed. Several slender bottle-green cypresses flank the path at diminishing depths, nearest at x=24%,y=40%-67% and x=79%,y=42%-65%, smaller below y=49%; no cypress above y=39%. Loose drifts of tiny white/pink/cobalt flowers follow path edges, small scale with perspective. Paint full lawn behind cypresses and drifts, without cutout holes, ample 60px hidden overscan behind future foreground bouquets. Everything above ground and around protruding tree silhouettes is ACTUAL alpha transparency. Do not paint sky, moon, distant hills, horizon backdrop, large flowers, foreground bouquets, trailing upper foliage or buildings. No gray/checkerboard/white backdrop. Visibly handpainted gouache and watercolor on subtle paper, atmospheric soft edges at horizon, delicate drybrush grass and gravel pigment, less photographic than reference.
layersAndInsects: Use reference for painterly style and overall spatial alignment. Paint ONLY two slender botanical flower sprays for the sides of a parallax garden on GENUINE TRANSPARENT background. Full portrait 2:3 canvas, intended 2000x3000, do not tightly crop. Two separate plants: at left a graceful spray of rose-pink wild roses with simple notched petals and small blue cornflowers, at right violet bearded iris with three upright standards, downward falls, yellow beards, sword leaves and a few tiny creamy narcissus. Smaller than the reference foreground flowers and more muted/cool. Flower heads lie between y=49%-71%, all stems finish near y=86%. Both clusters fit x=5%-30% and x=74%-97%. Entire central corridor x=35%-65% and whole upper 45% totally transparent. Keep sprays sparse and airy, with distinct stems/leaves, realistic asymmetry, no floating blooms. They will lie behind lush foreground bouquets. Extend stems down an extra 60 pixels equivalent for hidden overlap. No background, no sky, no lawn, no path, no mountains or trees. Actual alpha including holes between stems and petals, no painted black/gray/white backdrop or shadow. Original mid-century gouache and watercolor botanical plate, fine naturalist detail, layered pigment, visible subtle paper grain within painted areas, delicate hairline highlights, luminous colors with muted olive/bottle-green foliage. Hand-made brushwork, never photographic, vector, glossy 3D, smooth airbrush or cartoon. No text, letters, logos, watermarks, signatures, frames, architecture.

Use reference as visual guide to create ONLY the close foreground botanical framing on GENUINE TRANSPARENT background. Full portrait 2:3 canvas, intended 2000x3000. Preserve the luscious corner arrangements, brilliant flowers and botanical detail from reference, with slightly more visible gouache strokes. Two lush dense bouquets attached to lower left and lower right corners, stems/leaves extend beyond side/bottom frame edges, with buds and berries. Leave center path corridor x=40%-60% COMPLETELY TRANSPARENT over entire height. NO sky, moon, landscape, hills, trees, lawn, gravel or path. Lower bouquets have uppermost heads at y=44%, and fill both side wedges thickly below y=62%. Left: vermilion scarlet papery poppies with black basal blotches, violet bearded iris with yellow beard and sword leaves, a layered pale rose-pink peony, yellow trumpet daffodils, blue cornflowers, yellow marigold, blackberries, small white and pink blossoms. Right: pale cream six-tepal lilies with long stamens, ONE orange recurved spotted tiger lily, violet dark-center anemones, a striped rose tulip, pink notched-petal wild roses, red rose hips, black berries, fine dandelion clocks. Folded muted leaves show pale midribs and cool rim highlights, flower petal bases deepen and rims pale, faint warm light nearest viewer. Tall grass at lower SIDE edges only, not center.
Also include small hanging corner sprays, independent of bottom bouquets: blue morning glory trumpets with white star centers from upper-left extreme edge, and violet anemones, wild roses and hips upper-right. These only occupy outermost x=0%-20% or x=84%-100%, between y=0%-27%; center sky transparent. Keep whole horizontal strip y=31%-37% transparent. No flower or leaf touches x=50%. Alpha must be real, not opaque black/checkerboard/white; all space between plants transparent. Extend covered leaves/stems under neighbors for generous hidden overlap. No insects. Original mid-century gouache and watercolor botanical plate, fine naturalist detail, layered pigment, visible subtle paper grain within painted areas, delicate hairline highlights, luminous colors with muted olive/bottle-green foliage. Hand-made brushwork, never photographic, vector, glossy 3D, smooth airbrush or cartoon. No text, letters, logos, watermarks, signatures, frames, architecture.

Paint ONE scientifically recognizable yellow Old World swallowtail butterfly (Papilio machaon), dorsal top-down specimen, wings fully spread symmetrically, head upward, body centered. Warm cream/cadmium yellow wings with crisp fine black veining and black borders, hindwings have blue scallops and red eyespots and distinct slender tails. Six delicate legs, two antennae. Entire insect visible with ~10% generous transparent margin. Square canvas; insect later exported at 600 pixels long side. Isolated on actual alpha transparency, absolutely no white/black/checkerboard field, no flower/perch or cast shadow. Fine gouache natural history painting, small brushwork and watercolor pigment, rich but restrained, compatible with original garden reference. Soft cool light from right and very faint warm from left. No glow. Original mid-century gouache and watercolor botanical plate, fine naturalist detail, layered pigment, visible subtle paper grain within painted areas, delicate hairline highlights, luminous colors with muted olive/bottle-green foliage. Hand-made brushwork, never photographic, vector, glossy 3D, smooth airbrush or cartoon. No text, letters, logos, watermarks, signatures, frames, architecture.

Paint ONE scientifically recognizable red admiral butterfly (Vanessa atalanta), dorsal top-down specimen, wings fully spread symmetrically, head upward, body centered. Velvety near-black upper wings with strong vermilion-red diagonal forewing bands, white spots near forewing tips, vivid red hindwing margins with tiny dark spots. Correct recognizable red admiral pattern, six delicate legs and two antennae. Entire insect visible with ~10% transparent margin. Square canvas; later exported at 600 pixels long side. True transparent alpha background, no white/black/checkerboard field, perch, plant, cast shadow or glow. Fine detailed gouache natural history painting with translucent pigment and delicate hairline scales, not a photo. Soft cool light from right and very faint warm left. Original mid-century gouache and watercolor botanical plate, fine naturalist detail, layered pigment, visible subtle paper grain within painted areas, delicate hairline highlights, luminous colors with muted olive/bottle-green foliage. Hand-made brushwork, never photographic, vector, glossy 3D, smooth airbrush or cartoon. No text, letters, logos, watermarks, signatures, frames, architecture.

Paint ONE small blue butterfly, recognizable male common blue (Polyommatus icarus), dorsal top-down specimen with wings fully spread symmetrically, head upward, body centered. Luminous periwinkle-cobalt blue upper wings, narrow dark borders, delicate cream-white fringes, tiny soft blue body, six fine legs, two clubbed antennae. No swallowtail extensions or invented spots. Entire insect visible with ~10% transparent margin. Square canvas; later exported at 600 pixels long side. Genuine transparent alpha background, no white/black/checkerboard field, flower/perch, cast shadow or glow. Fine detailed gouache and watercolor natural history painting with delicate scales and visible pigment, not photography. Soft cool light from right and faint warm left. Original mid-century gouache and watercolor botanical plate, fine naturalist detail, layered pigment, visible subtle paper grain within painted areas, delicate hairline highlights, luminous colors with muted olive/bottle-green foliage. Hand-made brushwork, never photographic, vector, glossy 3D, smooth airbrush or cartoon. No text, letters, logos, watermarks, signatures, frames, architecture.

insectsB.name: butterfly-swallowtail-closed
insectsB.prompt: Edit ONLY the butterfly's wing pose in the provided reference to make a HALF-CLOSED flap-animation frame. Keep the SAME identifiable swallowtail butterfly, exact colors, markings, antennae, centered head-up dorsal view, body position, body size, canvas dimensions and painterly technique. Lift both left and right wings upward approximately 60 degrees toward each other so their projected horizontal wingspan is about HALF the original open wingspan. Show both wing pairs foreshortened symmetrically, not side view, not fully closed, not a second butterfly. Preserve original body length and location for clean animation alignment. Keep the whole insect inside a square canvas with transparency. Single isolated original gouache and watercolor natural-history insect painting. Visible fine brush pigment, delicate hairline detail. Actual alpha transparency including all gaps and translucent wings, no opaque background, no cast shadow, no halo. No text, labels, watermarks, logos, frames, flowers or other insects. Square canvas with insect centered and fully inside edges.
